title: Read receipts
summary: Shows whether people read your messages. In a DM: a sent tick and a read tick on your own messages. In a group: small avatars of the people who read up to that message, and a sheet that lists them.

tick.description: sending and failed come from the send state. sent: the server has the message. read: at least one other person read it (DM), or every other member read it (group).

readers.description: Group only: the people whose newest read receipt is on this message, newest first. Empty in a DM.

avatarUrl.description: mxc URL of the member avatar.

readAt.description: Receipt time, when the server gave one.

nameAmbiguous.description: Another member of the room has the same name after NameNormalizer (bipe#825). The read-by row shows the @ after the name, as in timeline-rows.

isDm.description: RoomInfo.isDm. A DM shows ticks only (ADR 0141).

sheetReaders.description: The open read-by sheet of a group message, newest first. Missing while the sheet is closed.

openReaders.effect: Group only: opens the read-by sheet with every person who read that message or a newer one.

notes: Receipts are always public (ADR 0050): the client sends ReceiptType.Read only, never ReadPrivate, and always shows the receipts of others. No setting turns them off.
DM (ADR 0141): two ticks only, sent and read. No avatar row and no read-by sheet. Matrix has no delivered signal, so there is no delivered tick.

EventTimelineItem.readReceipts holds the users whose newest receipt is on that event. A user's read also covers every older message, so the tick of an older own message is read when any newer event has that user's receipt.
Group: the avatar row shows at most 3 avatars and a count; bipe_app_receipt_read_by is its accessibility label, with the count already formatted. Own receipts never show.
Only the newest own message shows its tick label as text; older own messages show the icon only. Screen readers read bipe_app_receipt_sent or bipe_app_receipt_read on every own message.
sending and failed use the chat-timeline strings. A failed message opens message-actions with retry.
